change_reason: Score quality once on every released sentence; measure latency on a fixed deterministic subset instead of repeating full corpora.

metrics.reporting_rule: Report each metric separately for each model, direction, and test set. Do not average General Test and IT Test.

normalization.input: Use released text exactly; do not apply corpus-cleaning rules after release.
normalization.output: Score raw decoded model text after removing only framework-added special tokens and surrounding whitespace.

inference.model_revision: Resolve the official requested revision to an immutable commit SHA before inference.
inference.generation_overrides: No model-specific quality tuning beyond mandatory model-interface settings.

benchmark.quality_scope: Score every released sentence exactly once per test set.
benchmark.latency_sampling: Select up to 128 rows deterministically by SHA-256(seed:row_id), without replacement, independently for each test set.
benchmark.ram: Peak process RSS across the full quality pass and latency probe, recorded separately for each model/direction/test set.
benchmark.model_size: Serialized loaded artifact bytes and parameter count where available.

selection_policy: Teacher/student or adaptation candidates may be selected only from the complete frozen comparison table for this protocol version.
